stories.headline: PP wins Andalusia regional election but loses absolute majority; PSOE records historic worst result, Vox becomes kingmaker
stories.summary: The Partido Popular of Juanma Moreno won the May 17 Andalusia regional election with 53 seats but fell two short of an absolute majority, forcing reliance on Vox (15 seats) to govern. PSOE led by ex-minister María Jesús Montero collapsed to 28 seats — its worst-ever result in the region — while the radical-left Adelante Andalucía quadrupled its seats to 8, surpassing the Sumar-IU-Podemos coalition Por Andalucía (5 seats). National party leaders Feijóo and Sánchez drew opposing interpretations from the results, with Sánchez pledging to continue governing and PP claiming the cycle ends 'sanchismo.'

stories.headline: King Felipe VI undertakes state visit to Canada amid Trump-era geopolitical realignment
stories.summary: King Felipe VI visited Canada on May 19-21, accompanied by Economy Minister Carlos Cuerpo, in a visit framed around bilateral investment, AI cooperation, and Canada's search for strategic partners as it diversifies away from US dependence. The trip included meetings in Ottawa with Governor General Mary Simon and in Toronto, where Felipe VI delivered the Joan Margarit Poetry Prize to Margaret Atwood and revisited his former school, Lakefield College.

stories.headline: King Felipe VI holds multiple royal audiences and cultural events including Heritage Cities and school contest
stories.summary: In the week of May 11-18, King Felipe VI held a series of institutional audiences: receiving winners of the '¿Qué es un rey para ti?' school contest at El Pardo (with notable remarks on diversity), hosting mayors from the UNESCO World Heritage Cities group on the occasion of International Heritage Day, presenting Codespa NGO prizes on poverty reduction, and sanctioning a fourth constitutional reform extending Senate representation to Formentera.

stories.headline: King emeritus Juan Carlos I shows notable physical decline during Sanxenxo sailing visit
stories.summary: Juan Carlos I made his second visit of 2026 to Sanxenxo (Galicia) May 13-17 for a sailing regatta, but observers noted a significant deterioration in his physical condition, with the 88-year-old requiring assistance from two people to disembark from his aircraft. Family members including Infanta Elena and granddaughter Victoria Federica visited him during his stay.
